description_en: Adds MAC addresses, system serial numbers, and BIOS serial numbers to the device ownership list of the current tenant in batches. Returns the record IDs in the input order of the added items after the transaction commit. Existing identities and duplicates within the batch are skipped. Returns an empty list if no records are added in the batch. The added IDs can be used to query or remove the records
description_zh: 批量向当前租户的设备归属名单添加 MAC、系统 SN 和 BIOS SN。事务提交后按新增项的输入顺序返回记录 ID，已存在的标识和批次内重复项会跳过。当本批没有新增记录时返回空列表。新增的 ID 可用于查询或移除
name: AddDeviceBelongIdentifiers

fields.help_en: The identifier type. MAC indicates a network interface controller (NIC) MAC address, SystemSN indicates a system serial number, and BIOSSN indicates a BIOS serial number
fields.help_zh: 标识类型。MAC 表示网卡 MAC 地址，SystemSN 表示系统序列号，BIOSSN 表示 BIOS 序列号
fields.name: identifier_type

fields.help_en: The identifier value. A MAC address must be a 6-byte address. A system serial number accepts 1 to 64 characters, and a BIOS serial number accepts 1 to 128 characters. MAC addresses are converted to the lowercase colon-separated format when stored, while system serial numbers and BIOS serial numbers retain their original values
fields.help_zh: 标识值。MAC 必须是六字节地址，系统 SN 接受 1 至 64 个字符，BIOS SN 接受 1 至 128 个字符。 MAC 入库时统一为小写冒号格式，系统 SN 和 BIOS SN 保留原值
fields.name: identifier_value

parameters.help_en: The list of device ownership identifiers to add. Each batch supports 1 to 1,000 items. Each item must include IdentifierType and IdentifierValue
parameters.help_zh: 待添加的设备归属标识列表，每批 1 至 1000 项。每项须提供 IdentifierType 和 IdentifierValue
parameters.name: identifiers

IdentifierIds.description_en: The IDs of the records actually added in the batch, returned in the input order of the added items. Skipped duplicates are not included in the array. An empty list is returned if no records are added in the batch
IdentifierIds.description_zh: 本批实际新增记录的 ID，按新增项的输入顺序返回。跳过的重复项不计入数组，本批没有新增时返回空列表

items.description_en: The ID of the added identifier record, returned as a decimal string. You can use this ID to query or remove the record
items.description_zh: 新增标识记录的 ID，以十进制字符串返回。可用于查询或移除该记录

IdentifierIds.title_en: 本批次新增成功的标识记录 ID，按新增项的输入顺序返回。跳过的重复项不计入结果，本批次没有新增时返回空列表。
IdentifierIds.title_zh: 本批次新增成功的标识记录 ID，按新增项的输入顺序返回。跳过的重复项不计入结果，本批次没有新增时返回空列表。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate the API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，可用于定位该次调用
